start.text: You wake up in a mysterious forest clearing. The sun filters through ancient trees. A worn stone path leads north, a bubbling stream glitters to the east, and something shiny catches your eye to the west.

path_north.text: The path leads to a crumbling stone tower. The door hangs open. From within you hear a mechanical ticking. A note on the door reads: 'Beware the guardian.'

choices.label: Turn back and go to the stream

stream.text: Crystal-clear water flows over smooth stones. A small boat is moored to a root. Upstream you can see ruins. Downstream, a waterfall roars in the distance.

shiny_object.text: You find an ancient brass compass half-buried in the soil. Its needle spins erratically — then locks on northeast. You also notice strange glowing mushrooms nearby.

choices.label: Take the compass and head northeast

tower_inside.text: Inside the tower, a mechanical owl perches on a pedestal. Its bronze eyes flicker. 'Three riddles or face oblivion,' it intones. You have no choice.

choices.label: Smash the mechanical owl and run

tower_back.text: Sneaking around the tower, you discover a hidden cellar door. Below: rows of dusty books and a glowing map of the forest.

choices.label: Take a book at random and read it

ruins.text: The ruins are an ancient library, submerged to knee-height. Waterproof scroll cases line the shelves. One glows faintly.

choices.label: Search for a way deeper inside

waterfall.text: Behind the waterfall is a cave opening. Inside: a dragon — small, iridescent, clearly asleep. A pile of treasure glitters nearby.

choices.label: Carefully take some treasure and leave

hidden_cave.text: The cave is enormous and filled with star-maps carved into the walls. At the centre: a portal shimmering with blue light. A figure emerges — you, from another timeline.

mushroom_vision.text: The mushrooms grant you a vision: you see the exact centre of the forest, where a locked chest sits under an ancient oak. You snap back to reality with the coordinates burned in your mind.

choices.label: Dismiss the vision as a hallucination

riddle_1.text: 'First riddle,' the owl says: 'I have cities but no houses, mountains but no trees, water but no fish — what am I?' You think: a map.

riddle_2.text: The owl nods. 'Second riddle: The more you take, the more you leave behind — what am I?'

riddle_3.text: Two correct! The owl gleams. 'Final riddle: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body but come alive with wind — what am I?'

tower_escape.text: The owl's eyes flash red! You bolt for the door — but trip on a loose stone and tumble into a portal that materialises at your feet. You land in the clearing, the tower now dust. The forest is saved from the mechanical guardian, and you from it.

scroll_power.text: The scroll grants you the ability to understand any language — including the language of trees. The forest speaks to you, sharing centuries of secrets. You become its guardian.

treasure_ending.text: You slip out with a handful of glittering gems. They turn out to be crystallised dragon tears — the rarest substance in the world — and they grant you one wish. You use it wisely.

dragon_friend.text: The dragon stirs! Its eyes open — warm amber, curious, not angry. You share your food. By evening you've formed a bond. You fly out together over the forest canopy as the stars emerge.

portal_ending.text: You step through the portal and emerge in a version of your world where the ancient forests never fell. It's a paradise. You decide to stay.

paradox_choice.text: Your other self says: 'Whatever you do, don't step through that portal — or we'll both be stuck here forever.' They look exhausted. Do you trust them?

choices.label: Trust them and find another way out

paradox_ending.text: You both step through. The paradox tears the timeline — but instead of destruction, it creates a new pocket universe where both of you exist peacefully, the first citizens of a brand-new world.

sage_ending.text: The owl bows deeply. 'Sage of the forest,' it says, 'the tower is yours.' The mechanical creature becomes your companion. Together you catalog every secret of the ancient woodland.

book_ending.text: The book is a journal — written by you, dated 100 years from now. It describes your life in this forest in extraordinary detail. You realise you were always meant to stay.

oak_chest.text: The ancient oak stands alone in the centre of the forest. The locked chest hums. You reach out — it opens at your touch. Inside is a mirror that shows not your reflection but your deepest truth.

mirror_ending.text: The mirror shows you exactly who you are — and who you could become. You emerge from the forest changed, carrying the image in your heart. Every step forward feels purposeful.
